{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low in early periods, showing significant undershoot that gradually converges to within 0.5 of true values by day 15-20",
    "Sentiment momentum amplifies forecast accuracy - matching sentiment trends improves alignment by 30-50% compared to flat forecasts",
    "Model exhibits mean-reversion bias, predicting prices return to ~67-68 range even when true prices continue trending 1-2 points daily",
    "Major forecast errors (0.5+ deviation) correlate with sentiment regime changes from negative to positive or vice versa",
    "Lag effect: model 3-5 day behind true price movements, particularly at trend inflection points",
    "Sentiment strength directly correlates with forecast magnitude - stronger sentiment signals produce more aggressive deviations from baseline mean-reversion forecasts",
    "When price volatility spikes (0.5+ daily change), model forecasts become excessively conservative, under-predicting by 0.3-0.7"
] }
